Description.Title: Luque 2023: HCC recurrence in regenerating liver, 2D section
Description.Details: Source: Luque et al. PLoS Computational Biology 2023, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1010920. Explicit off-lattice 3D cell agents plus reaction-diffusion substrates; translated to 2D cellular Potts cells. Biological time unit is day, 1 day = 1440 min. Lattice node = 4 micrometres. The circular remnant is a planar representative section, not a literal 70% excision of a 2D lobule. The 70% injury occurs outside this surviving section and drives a normalized regenerative signal. Initial remnant radius 200 um follows published Tejido.cpp; initial number follows close packing of cells of volume 8000 um^3. Single residual cancer cell initialized using clone_mode=center; the central case follows the representative Fig.10a section and the random case follows the Fig.9 location study. The published params.ini seed 54321 is retained; no future cells are initialized. Tables 4, 6, 7 supply oxygen D=100000 um^2/min, decay=0.1/min, uptake=10/min, vascular oxygen=38 mmHg, proliferation threshold=10 mmHg, liver 33.6 h and cancer 38.6 h cycle duration, one liver division with probability 0.7, unlimited cancer divisions. Ki67 negative durations are G1 minus 2.5 h; positive premitotic durations are S+G2+M; positive postmitotic duration is 2.5 h. Cell fluid, nuclear-solid and cytoplasmic-solid volumes follow supplement Eqs.33-46 and halve on division. 2D target area = pi*(3V/(4pi))^(2/3)/dx^2. This is an isotropic sphere projection, not a 3D cell count prediction. Source Fig.6 constrains early doubling of hypertrophic volume, relaxation to 1.5-fold and finite liver proliferation. Growth-factor diffusion length sqrt(1000000/0.5)=1414 um exceeds the domain; a well-mixed signal is approximated with an implicit update at the reported decay rate. Its source equals current unrecovered liver mass fraction, an explicit homeostatic closure where the published secretion feedback is underspecified. A second bulk homeostatic substrate X follows published Celula.cpp (hepatocyte secretion 10/min, saturation 1, cancer secretion 0) and Parametros.cpp (X threshold 0.25). Its secretion is weighted by the surviving 3D liver volume implied by Tejido.cpp: 2923 original cells, 876 surviving hepatocytes, scaled by the simulated liver volume fold and divided by the reported 1mm^3 substrate box. This is a declared representative-section closure. The cancer cycle-entry gate X>=0.25 and liver entry gate X<0.25 are the published source-code rules, not time schedules or fit curves. The main article describes a regenerative GF with different sign conventions, so X and the positive injury signal are recorded separately. Division additionally requires actual CPM area to reach 95% of the projected volume target, a declared mechanical growth checkpoint needed to avoid sub-cell-sized daughter cells in the planar lattice. Potential vascular sites retain the published hexagonal portal architecture; activation requires the cell occupying that site to contact at least five biological neighbors, a planar neighborhood approximation to the five-cells-per-3D-voxel rule in Section 3.1.2/Fig.7. No vessel sites are activated by time schedules. Cancer-associated activation additionally requires local oxygen below the reported 10 mmHg proliferation threshold, to represent hypoxia-triggered angiogenesis described in supplement Section 3.8.4, pp.41-42. The angiogenic threshold itself is not provided in the paper; borrowing the proliferation threshold is an explicit approximation. Regenerating hepatocytes activate vascular sites through local tissue occupancy. Oxygen is initialized to the no-flux steady solution. Diffusion and all oxygen reaction coefficients are divided by the same numerical factor 10000; stationary gradients and penetration length remain unchanged, while transient oxygen relaxation is slower. This approximation is declared and must be checked against runtime output. CPM mechanics approximate overdamped adhesion and compressibility; equal contact energies avoid imposed tumor sorting or directed motility. Surface, temperature and volume penalties are numerical parameters, not reported force coefficients. Necrotic/apoptotic deaths are disabled in the showcase because the published code initializes both oxygen necrosis thresholds and basal death rates to zero; no immune treatment is present in Fig.10. Oxygen-dependent quiescence is retained. Five PNG/TIFF states, per-cell state logs, aggregate mechanism diagnostics and exactly 100 population samples including both endpoints are requested.

Event.name: Oxygen-gated Ki67 cycle entry
Event.Condition: cycle_phase==0 and hypertrophy_phase==2 and divisions<1 and division_eligible>0 and rand_uni(0,1)<1-exp(-phenotype_step_days/G1_wait_days*oxygen_cycle_factor*min(1,max(0,(growth_factor-GF_prol)/(1-GF_prol)))) and homeostatic_signal_X<GF_prol

CellDivision.name: liver mitosis
CellDivision.Condition: cycle_phase==1 and phase_age_days>=premitotic_days and volume_um3>=1.8*V0*hypertrophy_factor and cell.volume>4 and cell.volume>=0.95*area_target_nodes

CellDivision.name: cancer mitosis
CellDivision.Condition: cycle_phase==1 and phase_age_days>=premitotic_days and volume_um3>=1.8*V0*hypertrophy_factor and cell.volume>4 and cell.volume>=0.95*area_target_nodes
